title: Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Graph Attention Networks with Nested Clustered Optimization for Multi-Asset Portfolios
abstract: arXiv:2611.19903v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nested Clustered Optimization (NCO) insulates asset allocation from Markowitz covariance ill-conditioning. However, classical tree clustering relies on static pairwise Pearson correlation, failing to capture time-varying, asymmetric downside risk contagion across multi-asset markets. We propose a unified deep graph machine learning architecture: Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Graph Attention Networks with Nested Clustered Optimization (ST-GAT-NCO) for multi-asset tactical allocation. The framework extracts temporal momentum and downside risk dynamics via causal dilated 1D-convolutions, then deploys a multi-head Graph Attention Network (GAT) over dynamic market topologies to learn latent spatial node representations. These learned embeddings define an angular metric distance space that guides two-stage downside NCO optimization under institutional constraints and turnover smoothing. translated_title: 面向多资产投资组合的嵌套聚类优化动态时空图注意力网络
translated_abstract: 嵌套聚类优化（NCO）使资产配置免受马科维茨协方差矩阵病态条件的影响。然而，经典的树型聚类依赖于静态的成对皮尔逊相关性，无法捕捉跨多资产市场随时间变化且非对称的下行风险传染。我们提出了一种统一的深度图机器学习架构：面向多资产战术配置的嵌套聚类优化动态时空图注意力网络（ST-GAT-NCO）。该框架通过因果扩张一维卷积提取时间动量与下行风险动态，随后在动态市场拓扑上部署多头图注意力网络（GAT），以学习潜在的空间节点表示。这些学习到的嵌入定义了一个角度度量距离空间，用于在机构约束与换手率平滑条件下指导两阶段下行NCO优化。在为期73个月的无前瞻性走前（walk-forward）样本外评估中……
tldr: 该论文提出ST-GAT-NCO框架，利用动态时空图注意力网络学习不断演变的市场拓扑中的潜在节点表示，以改进嵌套聚类优化中的聚类结构，从而捕捉传统静态皮尔逊相关性无法反映的时变、非对称下行风险传染，实现更稳健的多资产战术资产配置。
